name: Imaoka Saburou
source: He is the youngest and largest of the three. His father was an American soldier, and he was raised by a single mother. He got into an argument with a senior at his workplace and was imprisoned for attempted murder. He met Mimura and Shimotsuki in prison, they have been doing various crimes together ever since.
